newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 4.61 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 4.61 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's weekly tender was 4.61 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compared with the three-month HIBOR of 5.64904 percent at 0330 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.59 percent at the tender last week, it said.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue rose to HK$7.11 billion from HK$5.85 billion at the pervious tender. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
